description: Source code implementing a Content Decryption Module (CDM) interface for DRM systems, including classes for managing sessions, buffers, and system factories, with plugin initialization and support checking.

classes.name: OCDMImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing DRM system factories, sessions, and plugin lifecycle, supporting initialization, deinitialization, and capability queries.

classes.name: ExternalAccess
classes.description: Handles external RPC communication for content decryption interface.

classes.name: AccessorOCDM
classes.description: Provides access to DRM systems, manages sessions, and supports content type support checks.

classes.name: BufferAdministrator
classes.description: Manages buffer allocation and release for DRM sessions.

classes.name: SessionImplementation
classes.description: Represents a DRM session, manages session data, and handles key messages and status updates.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration class for plugin settings, including system definitions and blacklists.

classes.name: Systems
classes.description: Represents individual DRM system configuration within the plugin config.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DRM plugin, loads system factories, and sets up communication channels.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, releasing resources and factories.

methods.name: IsTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system and content type are supported.

methods.name: KeySystem
methods.description: Retrieves a media key system interface for a given key system string.
